items.title: The Meroitic Inscriptions from Qasr Ibrim III: Inscriptions on Stone, Wood, Parchment and Gourd
items.note: Continues the edition of more than 700 Meroitic texts from Qasr Ibrim, a large body of non-funerary documents (ostraca, papyri, objects) for lexical work.

items.title: Amun in Meroitic Nubia: The Case of the Hamadab Stela
items.note: Discusses the Hamadab stela, one of the longest royal Meroitic inscriptions, as evidence for the Amun cult in Meroitic Nubia.

items.title: Toponymic Strata in Ancient Nubia until the Common Era
items.venue: Dotawo: A Journal of Nubian Studies 4
items.note: Sorts Nubian place names in Egyptian and Meroitic sources into linguistic layers, giving external evidence for Meroitic and Nubian vocabulary and distribution.

items.title: Meroitisches analytisches Wörterbuch (Meroitic Analytic Dictionary), DFG project 2017–2022
items.note: DFG research grant (2017–2022) for a bilingual analytic dictionary of about 23,000 entries drawn from roughly 2,300 Meroitic texts, most of them non-funerary.

items.title: Funerary stelae and lintels with Meroitic texts excavated at Sedeinga
items.who: French mission at Sedeinga (C. Rilly, V. Francigny)
items.note: The 2017 campaign added inscriptions for Maliwarase, Adatalabe and Ataqeloula, with kinship and office titles that enlarge the prosopographic corpus.

items.title: A Study of the Meroitic Inscription REM 1141
items.venue: Nubian Archaeology in the XXIst Century (Peeters)
items.note: Re-examines Amanishakheto's stela from Qasr Ibrim, one of the few long royal texts, building on the Edwards and Rilly transcription.

items.title: Où en est le déchiffrement du méroïtique, langue ancienne du Soudan ?
items.venue: Comptes rendus de l'Académie des Inscriptions et Belles-Lettres
items.note: Stock-taking of what can and cannot yet be translated, setting out the comparative Northern East Sudanic method and its limits.

items.title: Languages of Ancient Nubia
items.note: Places Meroitic among the attested and inferred languages of the Middle Nile.

items.title: Potential Old Nubian Cognates for Meroitic 'aleqese'
items.who: G. Ferrandino and V. W. J. van Gerven Oei
items.note: Tests three Old Nubian candidates for a recurrent Meroitic word, an example of word-by-word comparative translation.

items.title: Personal Markers and Verbal Number in Meroitic
items.note: Reconstructs verbal morphology through comparison with Nubian and other Northern East Sudanic languages.

items.title: Morphological Evidence for the Coherence of East Sudanic
items.note: Assesses whether East Sudanic is a valid genetic unit, the comparative framework on which Meroitic reconstruction depends.

items.title: Calling Out to Isis: The Enduring Nubian Presence at Philae
items.note: Study of Nubian votive inscriptions at Philae, with an appendix gathering the Meroitic-language texts from the site.

items.title: Language and Writing in the Kingdom of Meroe
items.note: Handbook summary of the script, the state of translation and the comparative evidence.

items.title: Le déchiffrement du méroïtique
items.note: Places Meroitic in a comparative volume on decipherments as a script read since Griffith but a language only partly understood.

items.title: Quand lire n'est pas comprendre… Le déchiffrement inachevé du méroïtique
items.venue: Bulletin de la Société française d'égyptologie 207
items.note: Lecture on why reading the script has not yielded translation beyond formulaic texts, and on the prospects of the comparative method.

items.title: The Linguistic Prehistory of Nubia
items.note: Reviews the Nilo-Saharan and Afroasiatic background of Nubian languages, including the case for Meroitic as Northern East Sudanic.

items.title: Amanishakheto in Meroitic Royal Texts
items.venue: Proceedings of the 14th International Conference for Nubian Studies (IFAO)
items.note: Surveys the queen's attestations across Meroitic royal inscriptions, part of a wider effort to read the royal texts beyond names and titles.

items.title: Meroitic-Corpus
items.note: Repository for the first machine-readable Meroitic corpus, with transliterated texts and data for embedding and alignment experiments.

items.title: 13th International Conference for Meroitic Studies, Münster
items.note: First meeting of the series since 2016, held in hybrid form because of the war in Sudan; its final statement addressed looting of Sudanese collections.

items.title: Towards Ancient Meroitic Decipherment: A Computational Approach
items.venue: Proceedings of the Second Workshop on Ancient Language Processing (ACL)
items.note: Frames Meroitic decipherment as a computational task, trains word embeddings on a new machine-readable corpus and tests cross-lingual alignment with Late Egyptian.

items.title: The Meroitic Inscriptions from Gebel Adda
items.note: Edition of the Meroitic texts from the Gebel Adda excavations in Lower Nubia, a large group long known only in part.
